new_results.statement: For orthonormal-column R and independent cap-one X, Y=R^T X has density bounded by product_i (1-ell_i)^(-(1-ell_i)/2) <= exp(k/2), with ell_i the row leverages.
Every exact rank-two same-sign quadratic form has density <= pi e / sqrt(abs(beta1 beta2)) for arbitrary independent cap-one inputs.
For exact rank three, a physical diagonal pivot of the minority inertia sign gives density <= 2 sqrt(2 pi e) [abs(a) abs(det Lambda) ell_i]^(-1/4).

Same-sign Pluecker determinant mass cannot be used directly as weights for the full two-pivot endpoint certificate: in the Hadamard target family its support is contained in the zero-full-determinant pairs.
